title: Forecasting lithium-ion capacity from sparse checkups: code, processed data and results
description:
Code, processed capacity tables (redistributed under the source licences) and cell-level predictions for the manuscript Forecasting lithium-ion capacity from sparse checkups: a prior-anchored residual learner that transfers across cell formats (submitted to the Journal of Energy Storage). The archive covers four public datasets (Luh–Blank, Sandia, Kirkaldy 21700, Oxford pouch). It contains the leakage audit, the original experiment scripts, every summary table, the figure sources, and a Level-1 script that re-derives all reported numbers from the deposited predictions in about 15 seconds.

The code is released under the MIT licence. Derived data keep the source licences: CC BY 4.0 for Luh–Blank and Kirkaldy, and ODbL 1.0 for Oxford. Sandia cell-level data are not redistributed. See DATA_LICENSE.md.
